messages:
nina_csm: Quick weekly health check for Solaris (focus: p95/p99 by route/model and streaming vs non-stream). TL;DR: overall usage +12% but streaming p99 regressed on /chat-complete with redwood-70b-v2. Details below.

nina_csm: Snapshot table (round numbers):
```
Route | Model | Mode | p95(ms) | p99(ms)
/chat-complete | redwood-70b-v2 | streaming | 410 | 820
/chat-complete | redwood-70b-v2 | non-stream | 260 | 500
/condense | llama-13b-instruct | streaming | 170 | 340
/condense | llama-13b-instruct | non-stream | 140 | 260
/vectorize | embed-lite | n/a | 95 | 170
```

tom_cs_eng: Oof, that's a visible tail. Any config changes on the customer side?

nina_csm: Customer said they rolled a feature that increases multi-turn depth; retention of conversation context up to ~6 turns. They started that on 2026-03-20 morning.

raj_infra: Instrumentation notes: on hosts serving Solaris streaming, we saw an increase in GC cycles in the stream worker process and swap activity on two older nodes around 2026-03-20 14:30 UTC. KV cache hit ratio dropped from ~68% to ~41% for redwood-70b-v2 streams.

suzie_sre: Error rates stable (0.3% for chat-complete), no increased 5xx noise. But queue latency for streaming requests hit >350ms for short windows. No pagers yet.

omar_runtime: Possible causes: longer prefixes + streaming keeps KV alive and increases memory churn; if kernel selection changed recently for redwood-70b-v2 that might push streaming onto slower codepath. I'll check runtime rollout history.

ops-bot: rollout-log: redwood-70b-v2 kernel optimization changed on 2026-03-18T02:20:00Z (id: kopt-3b). No customer flags changed.

omar_runtime: kopt-3b included a new attention kernel that generally improved throughput but has higher memory working set for streaming. That aligns with the memory + swap we saw. Short-term mitigation: route Solaris streaming traffic away from kopt-3b nodes and to nodes with kopt-legacy for a few hours. Medium-term: tune the kernel memory footprint.

raj_infra: I can split the pool: create a small set of legacy-kernel instances and pin Solaris streaming there for the next 6-12 hours to see if tail reduces. ETA 30m to move flows.

suzie_sre: Add an alert: if streaming p99 > 700ms for >15m, page oncall. I'll create the watch rule and add a dashboard panel for per-route p99 by mode.

nina_csm: Customer impact / renewal notes: Solaris usage is increasing and they're in mid-year renewal talks. They saw degraded UX in some sessions — risk now medium if tail persists into next week. We'll be transparent: "we're actively mitigating and expect to reduce tail within 24h."

tom_cs_eng: Can we quantify expected improvement if we pin to legacy kernel? Even rough % would help customer comms.

omar_runtime: Expect p99 on streaming /chat-complete to drop ~25-35% if memory thrash and kernel mismatch are primary causes. If network or customer-side long prefixes dominate, improvement smaller.

raj_infra: Pool routing change complete. Pinning Solaris streaming to legacy-kernel nodes now. Command used: ```bash
infractl route update --customer solaris --route /chat-complete --mode streaming --pool legacy-kernel-sol --sticky 60m
```

ops-bot: route-update: succeeded (op-id: route-774).

nina_csm: Please post updated p95/p99 after 1h and 3h so I can update the customer note.

raj_infra: 1h update: KV hit ratio recovered to ~66% on pinned nodes. Early latency snapshot: p95 streaming 410 -> 340ms, p99 820 -> 560ms. Will monitor 3h.

suzie_sre: Added dashboard panel and watch triggered once (p99 > 700ms) during transition window but cleared.

omar_runtime: Good signal. I'll still run a small 5% canary of a memory-tuned kernel (kopt-3b-mem) to validate. If it matches legacy-kernel performance with better throughput, we can roll.

tom_cs_eng: Can we also sanity-check output quality for canary? Solaris cares about hallucination rates.

omar_runtime: Yes, we'll run the canary against the eval set and compute BLEU/QA metrics and basic hallucination checks. Will include results in thread.

nina_csm: Action items: 1) raj_infra 50m: confirm 3h snapshot and keep pool pinned. 2) omar_runtime 56h: run canary + quality checks. 3) suzie_sre: keep watch rule active and notify if p99 > 700ms persists. 4) tom_cs_eng: prepare a short customer update template (I'll review before send).

raj_infra: 3h update: p95 streaming now 325ms, p99 520ms. Tail improved but still ~20% above non-stream baseline. No swap on pinned nodes.

omar_runtime: Canary (kopt-3b-mem) started; collecting 2h window.

suzie_sre: No sustained SLO breaches. Will escalate if trend reverses.

tom_cs_eng: Drafted customer note focusing on: investigation, immediate mitigation taken (pin to legacy-kernel), ETA for follow-up with canary results.

nina_csm: Thanks all. Renewal risk: move to low-medium for now pending canary. Will send note after omar posts canary results.
